question.text: Under Section 12 of the SEBI Act, which of the following intermediaries CANNOT operate without a SEBI certificate of registration?

answer.text: Only portfolio managers and investment advisers
Stockbrokers, share transfer agents, bankers/registrars to an issue, merchant bankers, underwriters, portfolio managers, and investment advisers
Only share transfer agents and registrars to an issue

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 12 of the SEBI Act requires every intermediary in this list — stockbrokers, share transfer agents, bankers/registrars to an issue, merchant bankers, underwriters, portfolio managers, investment advisers, and other associated intermediaries — to obtain a certificate of registration from SEBI before carrying on the regulated activity. The Trap: The three "Only..." options each cite a real Section 12 intermediary, so any one of them looks plausible. The comprehensive option is correct because Section 12 covers all of them together, not just one category. Note: The keyed option was rewritten as a standalone comprehensive list (instead of the previous "All of the above"-style wording) so the item stays correct under answer randomization. The unsupported Cross-Exam Context and Pro-Tip paragraphs were removed.
